title: IonQ annual net loss
definition: Annual GAAP net loss attributable to IonQ, Inc. (a pure-play quantum computing company) reported in its Form 10-K filings (fiscal year ends December 31).

sources.title: Form 10-K for the Fiscal Year Ended December 31, 2025

points.evidence: Item 1A Risk Factors: Net losses attributable to IonQ, Inc. were $157.8 million for the year ended December 31, 2023.
Item 1A Risk Factors: Net losses attributable to IonQ, Inc. were $331.6 million for the year ended December 31, 2024.
Item 1A Risk Factors: Net losses attributable to IonQ, Inc. were $510.4 million for the year ended December 31, 2025.
